behavior: AC1: git clean -fdx inside an ACTIVE lane leaves it ACTIVE for lane status, worktree list and a commit through the installed guard
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'func TestActiveLaneSurvivesGitClean(' internal/lane/*_test.go && go test ./internal/lane/ -run 'TestActiveLaneSurvivesGitClean$' -count=1

behavior: AC2: LoadMetadata prefers the admin dir and falls back to the in-tree lease; SaveMetadata writes the admin dir and the in-tree mirror, and refuses a non-worktree path
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'func TestLeaseLivesInTheWorktreeGitDir(' internal/worktree/*_test.go && go test ./internal/worktree/ -run 'TestLeaseLivesInTheWorktreeGitDir$|TestAdminDir' -count=1

behavior: AC3: dotf lane init copies legacy-only leases into the admin dir (changed=n, keyed on the admin dir) and a second run reports changed=0
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'func TestLaneInitMigratesInTreeLeases(' internal/lane/*_test.go && go test ./internal/lane/ -run 'TestLaneInitMigratesInTreeLeases$' -count=1

behavior: AC4: the guard reads the admin-dir lease first and the in-tree lease as a fallback in rules 5 and 6; every other guard case passes unchanged
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'admin-dir lease' internal/hooks/lane_guard_test.go && go test ./internal/hooks/ -run 'TestPreCommitLaneGuard$' -count=1 && sh -n ../git-hooks/lib/lane-guard.sh

behavior: AC5: mem session-end treats an admin-dir PARKED lease as parked from the root and a subdirectory, and still a legacy in-tree one
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'func TestIsWorktreeParkedReadsTheAdminDirLease(' internal/mem/*_test.go && go test ./internal/mem/ -run 'TestIsWorktreeParkedReadsTheAdminDirLease$' -count=1

behavior: AC6: worktree list names a legacy-only lease (admin dir empty, in-tree present) and not one the admin dir holds; every existing test in worktree, lane, cmd and mem passes
verification: cd cli && grep -q 'func TestListNamesALegacyLocationLease(' internal/worktree/*_test.go && go test ./internal/worktree/ ./internal/lane/ ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/mem/ -count=1
